superPowers.name: Strength of the New generation (Affiliation: Wakanda)
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, choose up to 3 allied characters. Give each chosen character an |<herb-rival>Herb| token. When a character with an Herb token attacks, during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, it may spend its token to add 1 die to its attack roll. During the |*Cleanup Phase|, remove all Herb tokens from non-Dazed characters. A character that has an Herb token removed in this way suffers 1 |!damage| and gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Pounce
superPowers.body: This character is Thrown |!movement_small|. It does not suffer |!damage| if it collides with another character or terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Untamed Force
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, this character may make an attack that has a |!power| cost of 0 against the attacker. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

erratas.body: Covert Armament's defense-dice lockout is no longer limited to a defender within range 2.
Strength of the New Generation now specifies the Create Attack Dice Pool step and only removes Herb tokens from non-Dazed characters during the Cleanup Phase.
Untamed Force no longer restricts the free attack to Vibranium Weapons, it can now be any attack with a |!power| cost of 0. Range is now 3 instead of 2.
The digital card states that the |*Pierce| special rule on Vibranium Weapons allows to change |!hit| results instead of |!block| results. The physical card does not have this typo.
